author: gyalchester
body:
I am going to LFT since it is holidays so i can be active everyday for 3 weeks for at least 5 hours xd

Past experience: T5 with Xenarch 

Position/s: Support/Mid - i can bridge well, i can nearly jitter bridge (without shifting)
                    Attacker/Rusher - I can get past people quick easily or kill them, i find myself quite well with the sword (i started to play pot pvp                             recently and have gotten much better) but not as good with the bow, i can use the bow close range though for kb.
                    Defender - I am not as experienced with building defences but i usually just stay and tank/kill people when they attempt to break                         the mon, break the core, take the flag or wool.

Languages: English and Affrikaans

Discord: lolew#1538

About me: I am 14, live in Australia, have 200+ ping but use it to my advantage, I work quite well with people, play strategically, sometimes toxic...

k thx
